newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Arafat says Israeli building plan violates peace.
newsitem.headline: Arafat says Israeli building plan violates peace.

text.p: Palestinian President Yasser Arafat said on Thursday Israel's decision to build housing for Jews in Arab East Jerusalem was a serious violation of Israeli-PLO peace moves.

"This is a big breaching to what had been agreed upon and it is against the United Nations resolutions and also against the American letter of guarantees and against all the agreements that had been signed," Arafat told reporters upon arriving in Nablus from Gaza for a visit.
Israel on Wednesday approved plans to build 6,500 housing units for Jews on Jabal Abu Ghneim, known to Israelis as Har Homa, in Arab East Jerusalem, despite international opposition.
An aide to Arafat said on Thursday the Palestinian leader was enraged by the decision and was concerned over the fate of Israeli-PLO peace moves.
Arafat flew to Nablus from Gaza where he was to chair a meeting of his cabinet and the executive committee of the Palestine Liberation Organisation (PLO) to discuss the Israeli decision.
Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu warned Palestinians against any violent reaction to the Israeli announcement and said Israel was prepared to deal with it.
